purpose: Document independent first-party local registry discovery and bounded anonymous cadastral-map access investigation.
assessment: Official English and Hindi discovery established the Kushinagar district revenue jurisdiction and UP Bhulekh/Bhu-Naksha services. The current UP Bhulekh JavaScript exposed encrypted API route names, but bounded anonymous requests did not produce parcel schema, safe native identity, or geometry. No GeoJSON sample is retained.
registryAssessment: Local administrative custody is evidenced by the official Kushinagar district site listing Tamkuhi Raj as a tehsil and its Revenue Department directory naming SDM Tamkuhiraj. State cadastral service infrastructure is evidenced separately; this is not evidence of a city-specific open vector layer.
